title: imap: build_credential_store credential_file path has no test coverage
description: The new imap::build_credential_store dispatches on secretx: prefix vs plain path, but neither branch has a test. The EmptyUsername tests added in bcd64f5 cover auth/src/store.rs directly; they do not exercise the imap dispatch. A future refactor of the dispatch logic would have no regression guard. The reader's build_credential_store_inner is covered indirectly by e2e_smoke; imap's is not covered at all. Scenario: operator refactors the dispatch string test and silently breaks credential_file loading for imap.
